children: ESPEY MFG & ELECTRONICS CORP reported fiscal 2026 revenue of $46.12M and net income of $11.18M, with diluted EPS of $3.89, reflecting year-over-year revenue growth and a sizeable improvement in profitability versus fiscal 2025.
Revenue was $46.12M, compared with $43.95M in the prior year; YoY change 5%.
Net income was $11.18M, compared with $8.14M in the prior year; YoY change 37.3%.
Diluted EPS was $3.89, compared with $3.02 in the prior year; YoY change 28.8%.
Revenue growth of about 4.95% was driven by expansion in magnetics programs and growth in field service activity.
Product mix is shifting toward new engineered products; management expects higher upfront R&D spending for these programs that may alter margins.
The company reported a $14.9M engineering backlog and a roughly $173M pipeline of likely award opportunities across power supplies and magnetics.
Operationally, ESPEY continued scaling manufacturing capacity, pursuing efficiency initiatives and plans about $500K of capex in FY2027 for machinery and facility upgrades.
Management noted risks including hiring challenges, extended supply-chain lead times and part obsolescence that could affect deliveries.
